same_names_elsewhere.note: A short unlabelled stub on the east side of Reading at the plate's tip, cut by the plate edge. It is probably Ridgeway's east part (jogged crossing).

reads.note: Two avenues come into Reading Road from the west: the upper one at y~548 and a lower one at y~980, which faces Whittier on the east side. I took the upper one as Ridgeway: Reading lots 3201-3221 lie between the two, which fits Ridgeway being at about 3224/3301. The north side of the street is cut by the plate edge at y~513.

same_names_elsewhere.note: Unnamed 'AVE.' (house nos. 17-545) meets Reading from the west, slightly south of the east stub; it could be a continuation if Ridgeway crosses Reading

reads.note: Reading Road runs NNE with a car track; the plate cuts it at the top. A short street stub cut by the plate edge comes in from the east at about (6480-6550, 415-495), with no name, only a 12in pipe. I identified it as Ridgeway by position: it is about 720 px north of where Whittier (printed) meets Reading at about (6200, 1130), the same spacing as Ridgeway and Whittier on 22-69. Ridgeway is not printed in the region.

note: The two reads took different legs of the Ridgeway jog: G1r1 the west leg (printed 'AVE.', the old pick's leg), G1r2 the east stub cut by the plate edge. No single new pick.
